Plot person-specific coefficients and their heterogeneity

Source: R/stats_plots.R
plot_coefs.Rd

One row per person: the person-specific estimate of term with its 95% confidence interval (estimate plus or minus 1.96 standard errors), sorted by size. The vertical line marks the random-effects pooled estimate from pool_coefs(), and the shaded band marks the range in which 95% of the true person-specific coefficients are expected to fall (pooled estimate plus or minus 1.96 tau). A wide band indicates that persons differ in the coefficient beyond what sampling error explains.

Usage

plot_coefs(x, term, ...)

Arguments

x

A fit from fit_lm() or fit_glm() that includes scope = "individual".

term

The coefficient to plot.

...

Ignored.

Value

Invisibly, the plotted person-specific coefficients (one row per person).

Examples

fit <- fit_lm(srl, y = "effort", x = "efficacy", id = "name", time = "day",
              scope = "individual")
plot_coefs(fit, term = "efficacy")
